testCase.name: [本地] S14 Purge with no page of that mode open: app closed, signed out, or working only in the other mode

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S14 「没有打开那个模式的页面时的清除：app 关着、退出登录、或只在另一个模式里工作」 Purge with no page of that mode open: app closed, signed out, or working only in the other mode

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 The purge runs on the server: records clear at their window whether or not any device has the app open.（TFA-94699 AC 7；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it.（UAT OAT-04 Expected 1；TFA-94699 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits: notes, transcripts and medication events from older visits are deleted; the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed; …（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT 3.6 (Nursing Home: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h, last two visits)；UAT 3.3；TFA-94699 AC 1 (Nursing Home line)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Four fresh physicians. A, B and C each have one Hospital patient whose vitals, labs, an active row and an open task are aged to 37 h: A has no session open, B has signed out, C is signed in with only the Nursing Home list open. …

When Wait the agreed purge lag (Q1) after the window with no page of the affected mode open, then read the raw documents

Then A, B and C: the aged Hospital items are deleted, the same as for a physician who opened the Hospital list. D: the visits older than the last two are gone

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 7 ('the purge runs on the server'), the 3.7 retention claim and 3.3 / U9: aged data still present for A, B or C, or a visit older than the last two still present for D, after the agreed lag = Fail

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

医生没登录、没打开 app、或只在另一个场景里工作时，什么都不清：37 小时的体征、化验、用药行，以及养老院超过最近两次的旧访视，会一直留着。

If the physician is signed out, has not opened the app, or works only in the other care setting, nothing is purged: 37 h-old vitals, labs and medication rows, and Nursing Home visits older than the last two, stay indefinitely.

依据：allure 22916e08-…-result.json; retention lane. 0 checks pass, 5 fail, all known K12: the purge is a client-called mutation and crons.ts has only the session sweep. Control: running the client's own applyLifecycle removes the Hospital items. Q1 (acceptable lag) is recorded.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。

怎么测（retention/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Browser + API: physicians A (session never used again), B (signed out through Better Auth), C (browser open on /snf only), D (NH resident with 4 visits, browser open on /rounding only); items aged 37 h; run the app's cron (sessions:_sweep), keep the pages open 3 minutes, raw rows read by admin without any client purge call. Traces are off in retention.config.ts (a trace holds JWTs and the session cookie); the first run's trace.zip was deleted. — Q1 lag is undecided, but main has no server job at all, so any lag gives the same answer; recorded with the lag used.
